items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 7:1
items.html: (To the question) By means of the upper coupling of AB and SAG, which brings the bottom Hey down from the eyes, and returns the HB to the Rosh, the male attains the aspect of his face, but the female still needs the raising of MAN. Therefore their coupling is made in the aspect of face to back. As above, in the adjacent utterance. (p. 500, s.v. "above")
